label: Formulated and introduced The Principle of Utility & Harm Principle
description: John Stuart Mill formulated and introduced the concept of "The Principle of Utility & Harm Principle", which became a seminal contribution in ethics philosophy.
dialecticalTension: Formulating an epistemic apparatus to resolve central problems in ethics.
historicalContext: Introduced during the 19th Century Divergences as part of John Stuart Mill's canonical writings.
